title: Heard: the dev bar becomes a full log that anyone on the team can write to

text: Your exact words already appear first on every prompt: the assistant does that by hand today, and a hook will do it mechanically once you approve one settings line. New as of this minute: every minion and I can post to this log under our own names with one command, a post with a steady id evolves its card, and there is a chunk command that appends text to a card already on screen, which is the stream control you asked for. The dev bar minion is drawing it as one conversation with a name on every item. Recording the audio waits, as you said.
